title: Design System: VayuPlan — Editorial Climate Flagship

display.purpose: High-contrast editorial hero headlines on / (clamp 2.75rem–4.5rem, -0.035em tracking) and radial NAQI telemetry figures.

headline.purpose: Editorial band titles, Today's Smart Brief headings, and scenario anchors.

title.purpose: Workspace module headings, Copilot sections, and card headers.

body.purpose: Frameless AI guidance responses, analytical explanations, and Indian transit tables (65-75ch).

label.purpose: Numeric measurements with tabular-nums, IST timestamps, coordinates, and chemical units.

shadows.name: sheet-level-1
shadows.purpose: Baseline daylight sheet and structured analytical panel shadow.

shadows.name: sheet-level-2
shadows.purpose: Focused cards, active controls, and interactive surface elevation.

shadows.name: tooltip-level-3
shadows.purpose: Floating chart tooltip card, search combobox popover, and mobile Copilot drawer.

motion.name: ease-editorial
motion.purpose: Editorial reveal sequences, radial gauge sweeps, and drawer entrances honoring reduced motion.

motion.name: disclosure-grid
motion.purpose: Layout-thrifty accordion transitions replacing JS height: auto animations.

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Primary obsidian CTA on / transitioning cleanly to pine-teal on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--bg-obsidian); color: var(--ink-on-dark); min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid var(--bg-obsidian); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-primary); border-color: var(--accent-primary); color: #FFFFFF; transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: AI Copilot Trigger Button
components.description: Signal pine-teal interactive trigger for Gemini synthesis and plan actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { background: var(--accent-primary); color: #FFFFFF; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid var(--accent-primary); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: var(--accent-primary-hover); border-color: var(--accent-primary-hover); }

components.name: City Search Input
components.description: Solid WCAG 1.4.11 control-bordered location input (>= 4.0:1 boundary contrast).
components.html: <input class="ds-input-field" type="text" placeholder="Search Indian city (e.g., Delhi, Pune, Kochi)..." />
components.css: .ds-input-field { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; background: var(--bg-surface); color: var(--ink-primary); border: 1px solid var(--border-control); border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 14px; } .ds-input-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Obsidian Telemetry Command Banner
components.description: Dark pine-obsidian atmospheric readout panel housing the radial SVG arc NAQI gauge and dark-surface severity pill.
components.css: .ds-obsidian-banner { background: var(--bg-obsidian); color: var(--ink-on-dark); border: 1px solid var(--border-dark); border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; } .ds-card-val { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 48px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent-on-dark); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview: VayuPlan pairs warm mineral-ivory editorial clarity (#F9F8F5) with deep pine-obsidian environmental instrumentation (#0B1412) and frameless Perplexity/Linear-inspired AI guidance. Inspired by Watershed's disciplined typography/contrast bands and Electricity Maps' live telemetry legibility, / alternates warm ivory storytelling with obsidian live-telemetry showcase sections, while /assistant pairs a top dark Atmospheric Telemetry Command Banner (radial SVG arc gauge + 6 pollutant bars) and Today's Smart Brief with a frameless Ask VayuPlan Copilot and mobile-legible HTML-labeled diurnal exposure curve.
keyCharacteristics: Alternating Light/Obsidian Cadence: Warm mineral ivory (#F9F8F5) and pure crisp cards (#FFFFFF) balanced against authoritative pine-obsidian (#0B1412) live showcase and telemetry bands.
Signal Pine-Teal Accent Discipline: #0F766E on daylight surfaces (5.47:1 white contrast) paired strictly with #2DD4BF on dark obsidian surfaces (10.05:1).
Solid WCAG 1.4.11 Control Boundaries: #6B7874 solid border-control token (>= 4.0:1 across ivory, white, and stone) plus mandatory 44px minimum touch ergonomics.

Frameless AI Copilot & HTML-Labeled Curves: Conversational Gemini guidance sits directly on crisp surface typography without bulky 2019 chrome, paired with 11-12px DOM axis/window chart labels legible down to 375px.
Zero-Reflow Disclosures & CSS Token Plumbing: Every component reads semantic @theme inline utilities mapped to :root CSS custom properties.

rules.name: The Signal Teal Discipline Rule
rules.body: Reserve #0F766E strictly for AI triggers, active navigation/tab indicators, focus rings, and chart crosshairs on light surfaces, and #2DD4BF exclusively on #0B1412 / #13201D obsidian surfaces.

rules.name: The Solid Boundary Rule
rules.body: Interactive inputs, selects, textareas, and secondary buttons use solid --border-control (#6B7874), never translucent opacity modifiers that fail SC 1.4.11.

rules.name: The Color-Independent Severity Rule
rules.body: All 6 CPCB NAQI categories pair >= 4.5:1 light and dark-surface contrast colors with semantic icons, numeric ranges, and text labels.

rules.name: The Zero-Costume Mono Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums serves numbers, chemical units, timestamps, and station coordinates only—never decorative headings or narrative copy.

rules.name: The Layout-Clean Accordion Rule
rules.body: Use CSS Grid .disclosure-grid (grid-template-rows: 0fr -> 1fr) and hairline gap-px tracks rather than height: auto animations or broken 1D divide-* grid utilities.

dos: Do wire all styling through Tailwind @theme inline semantic tokens (bg-canvas, bg-surface, bg-subtle, bg-obsidian, text-ink, border-subtle, border-control, bg-accent).
Do keep interactive buttons, switches, and disclosures >= 44px height with explicit inert/aria-hidden modal isolation on mobile.
Do disable .animate-spin, .animate-ping, and .animate-pulse cleanly under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
Do preserve Stage 1-3 API contracts, AbortController request cancellation, non-medical disclaimers, and strict CSP.
donts: Don't bring back the 32px drafting grid (.bg-drafting-grid), cobalt #1D4ED8 defaults, neon blurs, or >1px colored left borders.
Don't add eyebrow kickers above headings, gradient display text, fake customer logos, testimonials, or enterprise SaaS pricing.
Don't render SVG chart labels small enough to shrink below readable HTML size on 375px viewports.
